name: hr_performance
summary: Objective hierarchy + KPIs, review templates, weighted 360 feedback, check-ins, development plans, improvement plans and calibration with an append-only audit
description: Production performance management on top of hr_appraisal without migrating its tables: goals become a company / department / individual cascade with measurable targets, actuals and achievement percent plus discrete KPIs tracked over a period; appraisals are seeded from a reusable criteria template and rolled up with a weighted multi-rater (manager / peer / subordinate / self / external) 360 score; periodic check-ins, development plans with tracked actions and formal maker-checker improvement plans are captured; and calibration sessions let reviewers propose, adjust and approve ratings and apply them to the appraisal with an append-only audit trail. Consistent with the blueprint guardrail a performance rating NEVER mutates pay - finalization, PIP approval and calibration only record an evaluation. Extends the hr anchor, hr_appraisal and hr_skill; navigated under the single HR app.
author: Nexa
